Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

Mote 1 — if intermediate values are required, they should preferably be chosen from R 20 series (mm) [see IS : 1076-1967 Preferred numbers ( first revision ) ]. 

Note 2— The tolerance on length may be ± 2 mm for potentiometers with high rated dissipation. 

Note 3 — Chamfer at 40 d /50° or a radius for a depth of between 5 percent and 10 percent of dimension A 

Note 4 — For moulded or insulated spindles, the tolerance for dimension C push-on-knobs may require modification to obtain the required withdrawal forces. The 
components specification shall indicate the correct dimension. 
Note 5 — The underlined dimensions are preferred diameters. 
Note 6 — Attention is drawn to the fact that dimensions A and C are interrelated. 
Note 7 — Values for dimension B are chosen from R 20 series (mm) [see IS : 1076-1967 ]. 

Note 8— Fixing of bush may be done by pressing a 'C washer in the groove cut on the spindle to a depth of 1 to 1*5 mm. 
Note 9 — Dimensions apply to spindles after suitable finish. 

*IS : 919 ( Part 1 ) - 1963 Recommendations for limits and fits for engineering; Part 1 General engineering ( first revision ).
